title: Dashboards
markdown:
Dashboards allow you to visualize data that impact the security efforts on the overall Threat Intelligence lifecycle. You can gain a better understanding of the threats your organization faces. Analysts from the threat intelligence teams can monitor the flow of threat intelligence data in an actionable and meaningful way.

For more information, see [Dashboards](https://techdocs.cyware.com/ctix/en/dashboards.html).
